name: pioarduino-vscode-debug
description: pioarduino debugger for VSCode with MI3/MI4 support

platformio-debug.trace.enabled.description: Enable ESP32 RISC-V trace commands and auto-decode.

platformio-debug.trace.captureDir.description: Directory for trace capture files (relative to workspace root or absolute).

platformio-debug.trace.core.description: Core ID filter for trace analysis commands. Null decodes all cores in the capture.

platformio-debug.trace.mode.description: Trace capture mode sent to OpenOCD trace start.

platformio-debug.trace.autoDecodeOnStop.description: Automatically decode the last capture file when a debug session terminates.

platformio-debug.trace.elfPath.description: Path to the firmware ELF used for trace decoding. Empty auto-detects from the active debug session or .pio/build/<env>/.

platformio-debug.trace.chip.description: Trace-capable chip override (e.g. esp32c5, esp32c6, esp32s31). Empty auto-detects from the ELF/board.

platformio-debug.trace.targetArch.description: Target architecture override. Empty auto-detects from the ELF machine type.

platformio-debug.trace.coreDir.description: PlatformIO core directory. Empty uses PLATFORMIO_CORE_DIR or ~/.platformio.

platformio-debug.trace.packagesDir.description: PlatformIO packages directory for toolchain discovery. Empty uses <coreDir>/packages.

platformio-debug.trace.buildDir.description: Build directory for ELF discovery. Empty auto-detects from platformio.ini.

platformio-debug.trace.usePlatformIOConf.description: Use platformio.ini to resolve build directory and board for trace decoding.

platformio-debug.trace.gdbPath.description: Path to riscv32-esp-elf-gdb. Empty auto-detects from the PlatformIO RISC-V toolchain.

platformio-debug.trace.addr2linePath.description: Path to riscv32-esp-elf-addr2line for source line resolution. Empty auto-detects from the RISC-V toolchain.

platformio-debug.trace.openocdPath.description: Path to OpenOCD. Empty auto-detects tool-openocd-esp32.

platformio-debug.trace.romElfPath.description: Path to the chip ROM ELF for layered symbol resolution. Empty auto-detects from tool-esp-rom-elfs or ESP-IDF roms.json.

platformio-debug.trace.captureTimeoutMs.description: Loop-capture duration in milliseconds sent to OpenOCD trace start. 0 uses the firmware default.

platformio-debug.trace.historyJson.description: Emit history as JSON instead of the text format.

platformio-debug.trace.profileFormat.description: Profile output format for the Trace: Show Profile command.
